name: fresnel
description: Create, edit, preview and export Apple Liquid Glass app icons (.icon bundles, the Icon Composer format).

conventions.order: groups and layers are listed front to back
conventions.errors: MCP: isError with a readable message. CLI: message on stderr, exit code 1
conventions.cli: argument names are the input names with "_" → "-"; arrays are comma separated; objects are JSON; --args '<json>' passes everything at once
conventions.previews: approximations of Apple's renderer; the final check is Icon Composer / Xcode 26 on a Mac

compatible: wording of descriptions, examples and verification
breaking: removing or renaming a tool or argument
stability.rule: Breaking changes bump contract_version to the next major. The frozen surface (packages/mcp/spec/surface.json) makes CI fail otherwise.

tools.title: Create icon
tools.summary: Creates a new `.icon` with a background (color, gradient or system) and an optional dark background
tools.description: Creates a new .icon bundle (Icon Composer format). background accepts "#RRGGBB", "gradient:#top,#bottom", "auto-gradient:#color", "automatic", "system-light", "system-dark" or a color string like "display-p3:1,0.5,0,1".

path.description: Bundle path, e.g. "MyApp.icon" (".icon" is added if missing). Relative paths are inside the first allowed root.

dark_background.description: Background override for the dark appearance

overwrite.description: Replace an existing bundle. Default false

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

verification: icon_render_sheet shows the background in all appearances

examples.note: New icon with a blue gradient and a dark-mode background

tools.title: Inspect icon
tools.summary: Lists groups, layers, attributes and every variant
tools.description: Shows the groups, layers, attributes and per-appearance overrides of an .icon bundle.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

tools.title: Add group
tools.summary: Adds a group (the unit that carries the glass settings)
tools.description: Adds a group. Groups carry the Liquid Glass settings (translucency, blur-material, specular, shadow, lighting).

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

examples.note: A back group with some blur

tools.title: Add layer
tools.summary: Adds a layer from inline SVG, an image file or PNG data
tools.description: Adds an image layer to a group (the group is created if it does not exist). Provide either `svg` (inline SVG markup), `source` (path to an .svg/.png/.jpg file inside the allowed roots) or `png_base64`. Artwork should be a square, unmasked 1024×1024 canvas with a transparent background; it is placed at its natural size, centered.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

group.description: Group name or #index. A missing group is created in front (index 0); use icon_move to reorder.

file_name.description: Name to store in Assets/, e.g. "star.svg"

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

verification: icon_render_sheet to see the layer in every appearance

examples.note: Inline SVG; the "Front" group is created in front
examples.cli: fresnel add-layer Demo.icon --group Front --svg '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"><path d="M512 212 L594 420 L812 430 L640 566 L700 780 L512 660 L324 780 L384 566 L212 430 L430 420 Z" fill="#ffffff"/></svg>' --name Star

args.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"><circle cx="512" cy="512" r="300" fill="#7FB2FF"/></svg>
args.name: Dot

examples.cli: fresnel add-layer Demo.icon --group Back --svg '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024"><circle cx="512" cy="512" r="300" fill="#7FB2FF"/></svg>' --name Dot --props '{"opacity":0.8}'

tools.title: Set attributes
tools.summary: Sets attributes for all appearances, or a dark / tinted / platform variant
tools.description: Sets attributes on the document, a group or a layer. Pass `appearance` ("dark", or "tinted" = Mono in Icon Composer) and/or `platform` ("iOS", "macOS", "watchOS", "square" = iOS+macOS) to write a variant for only that case. Set a value to null to remove it (or to remove the override when `appearance` is given). See fresnel://schema/icon-json for keys and formats.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

verification: icon_render_sheet for the appearances you changed

examples.note: A dark-mode color for one layer

tools.title: Reorder
tools.summary: Reorders groups and layers, or moves a layer to another group
tools.description: Moves a group or layer to a new index (0 = frontmost). Layers can move to another group with to_group.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

verification: `groups` lists the new order (front to back)

examples.note: Keep the Back group behind Front

tools.title: Align or distribute
tools.summary: Aligns or distributes groups or layers (to each other or to the canvas)
tools.description: Aligns groups or layers by their bounding boxes (left, hcenter, right, top, vcenter, bottom), or spaces 3+ items evenly (distribute-horizontal, distribute-vertical). With one target, or basis "canvas", items align to the 1024 pt canvas. Only positions change.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

targets.description: "<Group>" or "<Group>/<Layer>" (names or #index); all of the same kind

basis.description: Default: selection (canvas when there is one target)

platform.description: Write the positions as a platform variant

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

verification: `positions` gives each bounding box in canvas points
icon_render to look at the result

examples.note: Center one layer vertically on the canvas

tools.title: Remove group or layer
tools.summary: Deletes a group or layer (unused assets go too)
tools.description: Removes a group or a layer. Unused assets are deleted from Assets/.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

dry_run.description: Validate and report the result without writing anything

tools.title: Validate
tools.summary: Runs the icon checks (schema and Apple HIG)
tools.description: Checks the icon against the schema and Apple HIG recommendations (square unmasked layers, opaque background, no text, variants, …).

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

tools.title: Render preview
tools.summary: Returns a PNG of one appearance as an image the model can see
tools.description: Renders an approximate preview PNG of one appearance and returns it as an image. Optionally saves it with `out`.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

appearance.description: Default: "default". Mono in Icon Composer = clear-light / clear-dark / tinted-light / tinted-dark

platform.description: Default: iOS. watchOS renders a circle

light_angle.description: Light direction in degrees, 0 = top (default), -45 = top-left

out.description: Save the PNG to this path

examples.note: Dark preview saved as a file
examples.cli: fresnel call icon_render Demo.icon --appearance dark --size 128 --out Demo-dark.png

tools.title: Render all appearances
tools.summary: Returns all six appearances side by side as one PNG
tools.description: Renders the six appearances (Default, Clear light, Tinted light / Dark, Clear dark, Tinted dark) side by side and returns the PNG.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

verification: Look at the returned image: every appearance should stay legible

tools.title: Export
tools.description: Exports the icon. Formats: "icon" (copy of the .icon bundle for Xcode 26+ / Icon Composer), "icns" (macOS), "appiconset" (Xcode asset catalog with Dark and Tinted variants), "png" (PNG set per appearance and size). Raster formats use fresnel’s approximate renderer. Assets.car requires Apple’s actool on macOS and is not produced here.

path.description: Path to the .icon bundle (".icon" is added if missing)

verification: Open the .icon in Icon Composer / Xcode 26 on a Mac for the final check

examples.cli: fresnel call icon_export Demo.icon --out-dir build --formats icon,icns,appiconset

color-space-for-untagged-svg-colors.description: Color space assumed for SVG colors without a profile

features.description: Format features in use (managed by fresnel: "specular-location", "refractivity")

supported-platforms.description: Target platforms: squares ("shared" or a list) and circles (e.g. ["watchOS"])

lighting.description: Light layers as one shape or individually

specular.description: Specular highlight: false = off, true = automatic, "inside" / "outside" = placement (needs the "specular-location" feature, added automatically)

shadow.description: Drop shadow under the group [default 推測]

glass.description: Render this layer as Liquid Glass [default 推測]

fill.description: Recolor the layer (uses its alpha as a mask)

cli_legacy_commands.build: fresnel build <spec.json> -o <Name.icon> — build a bundle from a JSON spec (fixtures/sample.spec.json)
cli_legacy_commands.inspect: fresnel inspect <Name.icon> — same output as icon_inspect
cli_legacy_commands.validate: fresnel validate <Name.icon> [--json] [--strict] — exit 1 on errors (--strict: also warnings)
cli_legacy_commands.render: fresnel render <Name.icon> [-a <appearance>] [-s <px>] [--mask …] [--tint …] [--sheet] [-o out.png] — writes a PNG file
cli_legacy_commands.mcp: fresnel mcp [--root <dir>]… — start the MCP server on stdio
